reviews.review_description: No after sales service, no phone number to ring that is not disconnected fake msg sent to say repairs are being booked

Who would purchase/install a solar battery system that did not supply power to a house when a power outage occured, well thats what GT Solar did to me had a black out today but battery did not back up house rang GT Solar, told me i need to pay $1200 that to happen, well see you in court.

GT Solar was referred to us by an acquaintance who said their experience with them wasn't bad. Unfortunately our experience didn't go as well as theirs.To be blunt, pricing is the only thing the company has going for them.Initial communications with the salesperson were ok as he seemed knowledgeable having answered a number of questions and in a patient manner. However, he came across as arrogant and full of himself when questioned about certain costs (compared to other installers) saying other installers lie about costs and hide it within the finals price. He also said that he should have just lied and included the extra cost and even said he could do that to make us feel better about the overall price (came out to be half the cost of the entire market). It's clear that he would say what he needs to in order to get the sale across the line.That said, we decided to go ahead with GT Solar given their price and the fact that panels and inverters installers use these days are all pretty much the same.The salesperson, who was supposed to get installation schedule for us, pretty much dropped off. We had to contact him on a number of occasions to schedule a time for their sub-contracted electricians to come out for the installation. Communication within their team was poor as well. When I finally managed to speak with the person in-charge of scheduling jobs, they knew nothing of the 2-stage installation process that was agreed upon (which we also paid for) and kept telling me that they couldn't do the installation in 2-steps. This eventually was sorted after several phone calls and going back and forth.The scheduler was a pain to deal with - never got back to me and kept arguing with me rather than listening to what I had to say.I wasn't home when the installation happened but wasn't pleased to find that they had left garbage around the house and on the roof. They turned the hot-water switch off but didn't turn it back on which likely affected the hot-water timer as well, both of which we only found out after we ran out of hot water.If pricing is your only concern, GT Solar may be the way to go. However, I wouldn't recommend them as their customer service is pretty poor and I'm hoping we don't have any issues going forward.
